title: Consumer Product Safety Commission: product recalls and NEISS injury data
questions: consumer product recalls announced this year
recalls of cribs, dressers or strollers
emergency department visits for injuries involving a product (NEISS)
national estimate of injuries by product, age or sex

manual.how: Recalls: open the Recall API link (https://www.saferproducts.gov/RestWebServices/Recall?format=json&RecallDateStart=YYYY-MM-DD) in a browser and save the JSON. NEISS: open https://www.cpsc.gov/cgibin/NEISSQuery/home.aspx, pick a User Affiliation, choose the year under Archived Annual NEISS Data with File Format Tab Delimited Text, click Find Data, save the file. Upload with ingest.

cache.why: Recalls are added and updated daily; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: CPSC recall notices and NEISS public-use data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission, {dataset}, saferproducts.gov and cpsc.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Recalls or injuries? Recalls list products CPSC and firms recalled (counts of recalls and units); NEISS estimates emergency-department visits for injuries associated with products (national estimates from a sample, not counts of incidents). Default: recalls for 'recalled products', NEISS for 'how many injuries'.
Which period? Recalls by announcement date (RecallDateStart/End); NEISS by treatment year. Default: the last full calendar year.
